title: オーシャンSの後に・カワイイの秘策

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That was good. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, Big Bro? Did my feelings reach you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, Big Sis? Did my feelings reach you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha. I'm glad you're being honest. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now then! Next up is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen… I'll be up against Biko.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. Well, naturally…

text_block_list.name: High School Student A
text_block_list.text: Have you heard about the Cutie ♪ Derby? You know, the thing Curren's planning.

text_block_list.name: High School Student B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! There's no way it's not awesome—like, this year's top trends level, I bet. I'm sooo excited. Curren's totally got this.

text_block_list.name: High School Student A
text_block_list.text: My dad likes that one race… the Arima Kinen, I think? I'll tell him to watch Curren's races too. Or, like, I'll make him!

text_block_list.name: High School Student B
text_block_list.text: I'm totally gonna watch the Takamatsunomiya Kinen with my mom. Curren's so awesome!
I knew it made a big splash and got people talking the day she launched the project—it even became a top search term. But it looks like the hype has grown more since then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm getting tons of shares and views on the homepage. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It looks like it's gonna be even bigger than my training series! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Our initial preparations really couldn't be going any better. Now…
choice_data_list: All that's left is to win.
All that's left is to win.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But there's one thing on my mind…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Hi, I'm Curren Chan! ♪ Today, I'm gonna do a cute dance just for you. ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Hm, hm, hmmmm! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …So I started doing cute things like this on UmaTok.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I kept working at it, and now I'm getting a hundred times more likes than when I started.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know, but… I still can't get more likes than Biko.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: She's been popular ever since the platform launched, so I guess I have to do more to win.
Curren Chan remains silent. "Cuteness" is her entire universe, the alpha and the omega. I can't imagine she'd abandon it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Of course! Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: There's almost no time before the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Looks like I'd better get serious. ♪
It's finally time for the big Takamatsunomiya Kinen and the debut of the Cutie ♪ Derby. Curren Chan's pride is on the line as the competition begins!
